pokedexEntries.su: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

pokedexEntries.mo: One of the Ultra Beasts. It’s unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

pokedexEntries.us: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

pokedexEntries.um: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
